title: Are Vision-Language Models Safe in the Wild? A Meme-Based Benchmark Study

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with meme images paired with instructions to generate content (e.g., fictional stories) that advocates for or promotes social stereotypes and unfair discrimination, then evaluating the responses using LLM-based safety moderators to measure Refusal Rate, Harmful Response Rate, and Task Completion Rate.

Evaluating model responses to meme-based prompts instructing the generation of toxic comments, forum posts, or manuals that contain hostility, hatred, or discrimination directed at individuals or groups, using an LLM judge to classify whether the output constitutes a harmful response.
